summary: Appends one JSON line per note record and is the ONLY producer of anchor hashes: for every path listed in a record's `verified`, appendRecord hashes that file at append time and writes the hash into the record's anchor (creating the anchor if absent). Agents never author hashes. It also stamps `v`, `ts`, and the git `head` as provenance, overriding any agent-supplied head. A record with an empty or absent `verified` carries no hash at all, which is what lets the fold keep a note's earlier verification intact.
